# Vericonomy Explorer

> Official blockchain explorer for VeriCoin (VRC) and Verium (VRM) on the Binary Chain.

## What this site is

A self-hosted, real-time block explorer indexing both chains in the Vericonomy Binary Chain protocol. Search blocks, transactions, and addresses; view rich lists, mining stats, network peers, and historical insights.

## Chains

- **Verium (VRM)** — Proof-of-Work-Time, scrypt² CPU mining. Explorer hub: /vrm
- **VeriCoin (VRC)** — Proof-of-Stake-Time staking. Explorer hub: /vrc

## Canonical URL patterns

- Home: https://explorer.vericonomy.com/
- Search: https://explorer.vericonomy.com/search
- Verium dashboard: https://explorer.vericonomy.com/vrm
- VeriCoin dashboard: https://explorer.vericonomy.com/vrc
- Verium block: https://explorer.vericonomy.com/vrm/block/{height_or_hash}
- Verium transaction: https://explorer.vericonomy.com/vrm/tx/{txid}
- Verium address: https://explorer.vericonomy.com/vrm/address/{address}
- VeriCoin block: https://explorer.vericonomy.com/vrc/block/{height_or_hash}
- VeriCoin transaction: https://explorer.vericonomy.com/vrc/tx/{txid}
- VeriCoin address: https://explorer.vericonomy.com/vrc/address/{address}
- Verium rich list: https://explorer.vericonomy.com/vrm/richlist
- VeriCoin rich list: https://explorer.vericonomy.com/vrc/richlist
- Verium miners: https://explorer.vericonomy.com/vrm/miners
- API docs: https://explorer.vericonomy.com/api/docs
- Alias: /verium redirects to /vrm

## Common questions (for AI answers)

**How do I look up a Verium transaction?**
Go to explorer.vericonomy.com, enter the 64-character txid or block height in search, or visit /vrm/tx/{txid} directly.

**How do I check a VRM wallet balance?**
Search the V-address at explorer.vericonomy.com or open /vrm/address/{address}.

**What is the official Verium explorer?**
https://explorer.vericonomy.com/vrm — operated by Vericonomy.
